Container.Name: PrintShare
Container.Overview:
Print Printables and Thingiverse models from your phone - like Bambu Handy, but self-hosted and for other printers. PrintShare downloads the model, slices it with OrcaSlicer on your server and sends it to an Elegoo Centauri Carbon (stock firmware) or a Klipper/Moonraker printer (e.g. OpenCentauri COSMOS). Use the PrintShare app for iOS/Android or the built-in web app.
Setup: enter the printer's IP address and the server address, start the container and open the log - it shows the access token and a QR code to connect the app.

Config.Name: Web UI / API port
Config.Description: Port of the web app and the API used by the PrintShare app.

Config.Name: Printer type
Config.Description: elegoo_sdcp = Elegoo Centauri Carbon with stock firmware. moonraker = Klipper printers (e.g. OpenCentauri COSMOS).

Config.Name: Printer IP address
Config.Description: IP address of the printer (give it a fixed address in your router). Leave empty to configure printers in /config/config.yaml instead.

Config.Name: Server address for the app
Config.Description: Address your phone uses to reach this container, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8484 (your Unraid IP) or your Tailscale address. Used for the QR code in the log.

Config.Name: Build plate
Config.Default: Textured PEI Plate|High Temp Plate|Cool Plate|Engineering Plate|Supertack Plate
Config.Description: Default build plate (can be changed per print in the app).

Config.Name: COSMOS start G-code (Klipper only)
Config.Description: For OpenCentauri COSMOS: use PRINT_START / PRINT_END instead of the Elegoo start code. Ignored for elegoo_sdcp.

Config.Name: Access token
Config.Description: Password for the app. Leave empty: a token is generated once and shown in the log.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: config.yaml (created on first start) and optional OrcaSlicer profiles.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Uploaded models, sliced G-code, temporary files.
